subject: EMEA+APAC weekend pulse — commit cleanup & stage updates
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: EMEA Sales Leads <emea-sales@redwood.ai>, APAC Sales Leads <apac-sales@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance Ops <finance-ops@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: EMEA+APAC weekend pulse — commit cleanup & stage updates

Team —

Quick pulse before the week out. Finance needs cleaned commit numbers for Q4 close planning. Please do the following by EOD Tuesday (1 Dec):

1) Update each open opportunity in your region with a stage classification: COMMIT / PROBABLE / PIPELINE.
2) For COMMITs, confirm expected close date and documented blocker(s).
3) Upload a single CSV (template attached) with opportunity id, ACV, stage, close date, rep name.
4) Flag any deals that require a credit, legal exception, or executive enablement.

Context: we saw several stage drift cases last week where ACV was counted as COMMIT without a signed PO. Finance will not include anything not classified properly in the committed total. If you have a large account (>$100k) at risk, ping me directly and loop Marissa.

Attachments: 20261130-emea-apac-commit-template.csv

Thanks — short and practical here. I’ll run a rollup Wednesday morning and share consolidated numbers.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
VP Sales, EMEA & APAC
Redwood Inference

From our side, procurement confirmed budget and PO is queued pending signatures — we can get a copy to Laura today.

Subject: Re: EMEA+APAC weekend pulse — commit cleanup & stage updates

Thanks Sophie — and thanks Laura for the early flag.

Short answer: Finance requires an executed commercial document (signed SOW or PO) to treat an opportunity as COMMIT for the quarter. LOI + PO-in-process is PROBABLE until we have the signed SOW or a copy of a fully executed PO. Please do the following:

- Laura: mark opp 11734 as PROBABLE in the CSV and add the PO status in the blocker column. Upload the PO pdf to the Drive link if/when you receive it.
- Sophie: please share a copy of the PO when it’s available (upload to the Drive link or send direct to finance-ops).
- Ben / Marissa: I’m consolidating final numbers Wednesday morning; if you have any >$100k at risk without signed documents, escalate to me now.

I’ll proceed with the rollup treating 11734 as PROBABLE. Drive link and HubSpot record are in the metadata above.

Appreciate everyone moving quickly on this — small cleanups now avoid a messy close.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
VP Sales, EMEA & APAC
Redwood Inference
